EQM00022.mathml:
<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mtable rowspacing="0.25em" columnalign="right left" columnspacing="0em"><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><msup><mi>x</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup></mstyle></mtd><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><mrow><mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>y</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi></mrow></mstyle></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><msup><mi>y</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup></mstyle></mtd><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><mrow><mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>y</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi></mrow></mstyle></mtd></mtr></mtable><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\begin{aligned}
x'&=(x-x_0)\cos\theta+(y-y_0)\sin\theta\\
y'&=-(x-x_0)\sin\theta+(y-y_0)\cos\theta
\end{aligned}</annotation></semantics></math>

EQM00025.mathml:
<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo fence="true">(</mo><mtable rowspacing="0.16em" columnalign="center" columnspacing="1em"><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="false"><msup><mi>x</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup></mstyle></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="false"><msup><mi>y</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup></mstyle></mtd></mtr></mtable><mo fence="true">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo fence="true">(</mo><mtable rowspacing="0.16em" columnalign="center center" columnspacing="1em"><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="false"><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi></mrow></mstyle></mtd><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="false"><mrow><mo>−</mo><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi></mrow></mstyle></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="false"><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi></mrow></mstyle></mtd><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="false"><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi></mrow></mstyle></mtd></mtr></mtable><mo fence="true">)</mo></mrow><mrow><mo fence="true">(</mo><mtable rowspacing="0.16em" columnalign="center" columnspacing="1em"><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="false"><mi>x</mi></mstyle></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="false"><mi>y</mi></mstyle></mtd></mtr></mtable><mo fence="true">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\begin{pmatrix}x'\\y'\end{pmatrix}
=\begin{pmatrix}\cos\theta&-\sin\theta\\\sin\theta&\cos\theta\end{pmatrix}
\begin{pmatrix}x\\y\end{pmatrix}</annotation></semantics></math>

EQM00028.mathml:
<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mtable rowspacing="0.25em" columnalign="right left" columnspacing="0em"><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><msup><mi>x</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup></mstyle></mtd><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><mrow><mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>1.08</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>0.866</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>0.91</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>0.5</mn><mo>≈</mo><mn>0.48</mn></mrow></mstyle></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><msup><mi>y</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup></mstyle></mtd><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><mrow><mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>1.08</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>0.5</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>0.91</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>0.866</mn><mo>≈</mo><mn>1.33</mn></mrow></mstyle></mtd></mtr></mtable><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\begin{aligned}
x'&=1.08\times0.866-0.91\times0.5\approx0.48\\
y'&=1.08\times0.5+0.91\times0.866\approx1.33
\end{aligned}</annotation></semantics></math>

EQM00041.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><menclose notation="box"><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="false"><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="false"><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><mrow><mi>h</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>H</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>N</mi></mrow></mstyle></mstyle></mstyle></menclose><mspace width="2em"/><menclose notation="box"><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="false"><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="false"><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><mrow><mi>H</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>h</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>N</mi></mrow></mstyle></mstyle></mstyle></menclose></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\boxed{h=H+N}\qquad\boxed{H=h-N}</annotation></semantics></math>

EQM00047.mathml:
<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mtable rowspacing="0.25em" columnalign="right left" columnspacing="0em"><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><mi>H</mi></mstyle></mtd><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><mrow><mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>h</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>N</mi></mrow></mstyle></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><mrow></mrow></mstyle></mtd><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><mrow><mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>85.000</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>35.000</mn></mrow></mstyle></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><mrow></mrow></mstyle></mtd><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><mrow><mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>50.000</mn><mtext> </mtext><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow></mstyle></mtd></mtr></mtable><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\begin{aligned}

 &=85.000-35.000\\
 &=50.000\ \mathrm{m}

EQM00053.mathml:
<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mtable rowspacing="0.25em" columnalign="right left" columnspacing="0em"><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><msub><mi>N</mi><mi>A</mi></msub></mstyle></mtd><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><mrow><mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>71.09</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>30.00</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>41.09</mn><mtext> </mtext><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow></mstyle></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><msub><mi>N</mi><mi>B</mi></msub></mstyle></mtd><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><mrow><mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>41.09</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>0.02</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>40.97</mn><mtext> </mtext><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow></mstyle></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><msub><mi>H</mi><mi>B</mi></msub></mstyle></mtd><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><mrow><mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>66.50</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>40.97</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>25.53</mn><mtext> </mtext><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow></mstyle></mtd></mtr></mtable><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\begin{aligned}

EQM00150.mathml:
<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mtable rowspacing="0.25em" columnalign="right left" columnspacing="0em"><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mi>X</mi></mrow></mstyle></mtd><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><mrow><mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>150</mn><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><msup><mn>120</mn><mo>∘</mo></msup><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>75.000</mn><mtext> </mtext><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow></mstyle></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mi>Y</mi></mrow></mstyle></mtd><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><mrow><mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>150</mn><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><msup><mn>120</mn><mo>∘</mo></msup><mo>=</mo><mo>+</mo><mn>129.904</mn><mtext> </mtext><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow></mstyle></mtd></mtr></mtable><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\begin{aligned}
\Delta X&=150\cos120^\circ=-75.000\ \mathrm{m}\\
\Delta Y&=150\sin120^\circ=+129.904\ \mathrm{m}
\end{aligned}</annotation></semantics></math>

EQM00151.mathml:
<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mtable rowspacing="0.25em" columnalign="right left" columnspacing="0em"><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><msub><mi>X</mi><mi>B</mi></msub></mstyle></mtd><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><mrow><mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>1000.000</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>75.000</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>925.000</mn><mtext> </mtext><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow></mstyle></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><msub><mi>Y</mi><mi>B</mi></msub></mstyle></mtd><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><mrow><mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>2000.000</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>129.904</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>2129.904</mn><mtext> </mtext><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow></mstyle></mtd></mtr></mtable><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\begin{aligned}
X_B&=1000.000-75.000=925.000\ \mathrm{m}\\
Y_B&=2000.000+129.904=2129.904\ \mathrm{m}
\end{aligned}</annotation></semantics></math>

EQM00153.tex: S=\sqrt{\Delta X^2+\Delta Y^2},\qquad\tan T=\frac{\Delta Y}{\Delta X}
EQM00153.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo>=</mo><msqrt><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><msup><mi>X</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><msup><mi>Y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></msqrt><mo separator="true">,</mo><mspace width="2em"/><mi>tan</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>T</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mi>Y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mi>X</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">S=\sqrt{\Delta X^2+\Delta Y^2},\qquad\tan T=\frac{\Delta Y}{\Delta X}</annotation></semantics></math>

EQM00160.mathml:
<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mtable rowspacing="0.25em" columnalign="right left" columnspacing="0em"><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><mi>t</mi></mstyle></mtd><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><mrow><mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>arctan</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mfrac><mn>129.904</mn><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>75.000</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>≈</mo><mo>−</mo><msup><mn>60</mn><mo>∘</mo></msup></mrow></mstyle></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><mi>T</mi></mstyle></mtd><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><mrow><mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><msup><mn>180</mn><mo>∘</mo></msup><mo>≈</mo><msup><mn>120</mn><mo>∘</mo></msup></mrow></mstyle></mtd></mtr></mtable><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\begin{aligned}
t&=\arctan\frac{129.904}{-75.000}\approx-60^\circ\\
T&=t+180^\circ\approx120^\circ
\end{aligned}</annotation></semantics></math>

EQM00166.mathml:
<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mtable rowspacing="0.25em" columnalign="right left" columnspacing="0em"><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><msub><mi>X</mi><mi>B</mi></msub></mstyle></mtd><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><mrow><mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>150.00</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>200.00</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>0.50000</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>250.00</mn><mtext> </mtext><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow></mstyle></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><msub><mi>Y</mi><mi>B</mi></msub></mstyle></mtd><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"><mrow><mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>250.00</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>200.00</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>0.86603</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>423.21</mn><mtext> </mtext><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow></mstyle></mtd></mtr></mtable><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\begin{aligned}
X_B&=150.00+200.00\times0.50000=250.00\ \mathrm{m}\\
Y_B&=250.00+200.00\times0.86603=423.21\ \mathrm{m}
